items.title: crypto: the core port takes the key-encryption key, the sign-in package and the associated data; the crypto module opens them
items.red_not_run: every test class of this slice uses types that do not exist on the base (the new core types, the new port methods), so none compiles there and no red leg is possible; the mutants carry the proof
